headlines.text: UK police confirm Uganda boxers unaccounted for after Commonwealth Games. Athletes from Uganda and Pakistan were reported 'missing' after failing to return home from 2026 Commonwealth Games.
Shifting US politics offers opportunity for Palestinian self-determination. Palestinian advocacy needs to actively engage with changes in attitudes among both Democratic and Republican voters.
Why is France developing a new nuclear strategy?. As the US retreats from Europe and Russia adopts an aggressive posture, France plans to add weapons to its arsenal
Iran anthem protest: Female footballers ‘proud’ to become Australian. Fatemeh Pasandideh and Atefeh Ramezanisadeh refused to sing Iran anthem at Asian Cup, now granted Australia citizenship.
Russian strikes kill six in Ukraine as Moscow intercepts hundreds of drones. Ukraine officials say three people killed in Kharkiv region and three in Sumy, as Russia says it intercepted 605 drones.
Ex-Bangladesh cricket captain Shakib’s home petrol-bombed in Hasina fallout. Former Bangladesh captain Shakib Al Hasan's home attacked after joining former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina’s event.
Messi scores his first goals since World Cup as Inter Miami beat San Luis. Lionel Messi scores his first goals since Argentina's World Cup final defeat to Spain, as Miami win 4-2 in Leagues Cup.
Pakistan beat West Indies to end 8 away Test losing streak and draw series. Pakistan win first away Test in three years, beating West Indies by eight wickets in Trinidad to draw two Test series.
A US proposal for missile defense that’s been tried before. What is a Golden Dome, and why does Donald Trump want one?
Ukraine escalates strikes on Russian shipping. Striking hundreds of targets in a matter of weeks, Ukraine has found a new way to pressure Russia's hold on Crimea
US military families face deportation after immigration protection ends. The spouses and parents of US service members have been reportedly detained or deported.
Carney curses Infantino as FIFA backs its president. FIFA’s President Gianni Infantino gets the support of executive members at an emergency meeting in Morocco.
Strait of Hormuz tolls would harm livelihoods worldwide, shipowners warn. Eight leading shipping organisations sign letter opposing fees in critical waterway.
Trump attacks El-Sayed as ‘hater of Jews’ after Michigan win. US President Donald Trump attacked Michigan’s Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, calling him a ‘hater of Jews.'
Could the Iran war derail Donald Trump’s legacy?. President Trump is looking to reframe the Iran war ahead of the 2026 midterm elections in November.

Retired NFL standout Roddy White suggests Ryan Clark's outspokenness may have played role in ESPN exit. Roddy White questions ESPN's decision as Steve Smith is expected to take an expanded role following Ryan Clark's departure from the network.

Trump blasts Democratic socialist candidate as 'full of s---' and Dems are skipping socialism 'for communism'. Trump singled out Abdul El-Sayed by name during a Las Vegas speech, calling communism the greatest threat facing the U.S. in its history.

Crowded Russian beach descends into chaos after alleged Ukrainian drone incident kills 7, including 4 children. A projectile struck a crowded Russian Black Sea beach Monday, killing seven people, including four children, and injuring 58. Russia blamed a Ukrainian drone attack as video captured the deadly impact.

Florida man accused of cutting off diver's air supply in fight over coveted lobster diving spot. A dispute over a lobster diving spot during Florida's lobster mini season allegedly turned deadly when a man shut off a diver's surface supplied air.

Bodycam video shows Canadian woman allegedly giving false name before deputies discovered 12 fake IDs. Body camera video shows Florida deputies finding 12 fake IDs in a Canadian woman's car after she allegedly gave a false name during a traffic stop.

Federal judge acknowledges Supreme Court ruling clearing path for Trump to end Haiti TPS. A federal judge has ruled that the court order blocking Trump's termination of Haiti TPS is no longer in effect after the Supreme Court's ruling.

Fauci's HHS iPhone turned over to Senate investigators as contempt vote looms. Sen. Ron Johnson's subcommittee obtained a copy of Anthony Fauci's pandemic-era iPhone as Rand Paul's panel weighs holding Fauci in contempt of Congress.

Dodgers ruin baseball with sixth straight loss, get swept for second consecutive series by Chicago Cubs. The Los Angeles Dodgers have lost six straight games after the Tarik Skubal trade, and their once-insurmountable 14-game lead continues to shrink.

Halle Berry sizzles in racy lingerie look for sunset beach stroll during Fiji getaway. Halle Berry shared stunning Fiji vacation photos in a gold bikini and animal-print cover-up as she prepares to celebrate her 60th birthday soon.

Masked man caught on camera smashing Virgin Mary statue with a hammer outside NYC church. Surveillance video shows a masked man climbing a fence and smashing a Virgin Mary statue with a hammer at St. Rita Church in Long Island City.

Amazon driver caught on video flinging customer’s package onto porch in infuriating delivery blunder. Ring camera video shows a Yun Express driver hurling an Amazon package onto a Florida porch, snapping a proof-of-delivery photo and walking away.

Former Kansas Jayhawks guard Brett Ballard seriously injured in single-vehicle highway crash. Brett Ballard's Ford F-150 struck a concrete bridge pillar on Interstate 470 in Topeka, sending the Washburn basketball coach to Stormont Vail Hospital.

Francesca Hong remarks Thanksgiving is her 'favorite holiday,' answers she does not 'want to cancel it'. Wisconsin gubernatorial candidate Francesca Hong remarked that Thanksgiving is her "favorite holiday" despite a deleted 2020 post urging America to "cancel" it.

El-Sayed's threat against GOP rival backfires as conservatives bring receipts: 'Is Dubai in Florida?'. Abdul El-Sayed's "safe quarter" remark directed at Mike Rogers after winning the Michigan Senate Democratic nomination sparks heated online debate.

Taxpayer-funded housing for illegal immigrants in GOP's crosshairs: 'It's got to stop'. Sen. Bill Hagerty's bill would require citizenship verification for public housing and block sanctuary cities from Community Development Block Grants.

Ousted Bangladeshi leader vows to return from exile despite facing a death sentence. Hasina's speech marked the second anniversary of her ouster. She fled Bangladesh by helicopter following nearly two months of protests in 2024 that left nearly 1,400 people dead, according to the United Nations.

Small Texas law firm set to receive $150M to represent unaccompanied migrant children. The firm, Houston-based Burke Law Group has only two attorneys who specialize in immigration and asylum cases. Two of its founders have ties to the Trump administration.

Dr. Erica Schwartz confirmed as CDC director, filling a leadership vacuum. Schwartz takes command of a public health agency that has lost thousands of employees, amid layoffs, resignations and leadership turmoil.
A Russian barrage in Ukraine's capital kills 17 as air defenses fall short. Ukraine's depleted air defenses failed to stop any of Moscow's incoming missiles overnight.
